segments.name: Northern homebuilding
segments.description: Builds and sells single-family homes and attached townhomes to first-time, move-up, empty-nester and luxury buyers in northern markets.
segments.evidence: Our homebuilding operations are aggregated for reporting purposes into two reporting segments - the Northern and Southern regions.

segments.name: Southern homebuilding
segments.description: Builds and sells single-family homes and attached townhomes to first-time, move-up, empty-nester and luxury buyers in southern markets.
segments.evidence: We have determined our reportable segments are: Northern homebuilding; Southern homebuilding; and financial services operations.

segments.name: Financial services
segments.description: Provides mortgage loans and title services to the customers of the homebuilding operations through M/I Financial and title subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: Our financial services operations support our homebuilding operations by providing mortgage loans and title services to the customers of our homebuilding operations and are reported as an independent segment.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay for homes delivered and land/lots sold, and financial services generates revenue from originating and selling mortgages and collecting fees for title insurance and closing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our financial services operations generate revenue primarily from originating and selling mortgages and collecting fees for title insurance and closing services.
